**🎤 Tomorrow: Mid-Program Event with GitLab Engineers!**
📅 **Thursday April 2nd | 11am - 12pm EST / 8 - 9am PST**
🔗 [Join on Zoom](https://us06web.zoom.us/j/85747208685?jst=2)

We're hosting a panel + Q&A with Senior Engineers from GitLab! Here's what we'll be covering:
🔹 AI & emerging tech - how it's changing day-to-day engineering work and what early-career engineers should pay attention to
🔹 Open source as a career lever - how contributions have shaped their careers and what they actually look for on resumes
🔹 Their journeys to and at GitLab - what their paths looked like and what surprised them about working there

Whether you're looking for inspiration, career advice, or want to learn more about working with the GitLab team in our program and beyond - this is a great one to attend!

**[Submit your questions now](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdTeIWqrcFP1oAfveaF2JSbbV7RMajg6C1Rz7uzkkV9vpP7MQ/viewform)** so we can make the conversation as relevant to you as possible!

Can't make it? The event will be recorded and shared!

Stuck on something and need help outside of the event? [Book time with Cam directly!](https://calendar.app.google/Ww9aLLNCvo5Mm2CRA)

See you there 🙌
